svg.title: “With great power comes great responsibility.” — Uncle Ben, clearly talking about AI coding agents Two shifts, one obsession: Kotlin that ships, and agents that can prove what they did. The day shift taught me that production is the only reviewer that never sleeps. A checkout used by millions forgives nothing, so I test the boring paths, measure before I optimise and leave the code a little cleaner than I found it. The night shift is where I bring that discipline to AI. Agents write code while I sleep and open pull requests on my home server; the harness checks them before I do, whether they come from Claude Code, Codex CLI or Copilot, and I benchmark local models like Qwen and Gemma against the same gates. Both shifts end with the same question. Not “does it work?”, but “how do we know?”
